summary: End-to-end testing of StagePass event booking app: 14/14 backend pytest tests passed (events, auth, bookings). Full frontend E2E flow validated: landing -> events list -> event detail -> protected route redirect -> login (demo user) -> seat selection -> confirm booking -> checkout confirmation -> dashboard My Tickets. All critical features working.
critical_code_review_comments: FastAPI on_event('startup'/'shutdown') decorators are deprecated; consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking, future-proof).
Seat-locking is optimistic: between GET /events/{id}/seats and POST /bookings two users can pick the same seat. Server-side conflict check exists (409) but no atomic reservation. Acceptable for MVP.
CORS uses allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True from default env - browsers reject this combo. Currently OK since frontend uses Bearer token not cookies, but tighten origins in production.
Token expiry 7 days is long for an MVP; consider shorter access tokens with refresh.
server.py is ~400 lines with models, routes, and seeding in one file - split into routers/models/seed modules if it grows.
test_credentials: demo@stagepass.app / demo1234 (seeded on backend startup) - verified working
seed_data_creation: Test created additional bookings for evt-midnight-laughs (J14, J13 by demo user). Test users registered with TEST_<uuid>@stagepass.app pattern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 pytest cases pass. Frontend booking flow (login -> select seats -> POST /api/bookings -> /checkout/:id) verified end-to-end with screenshots. Seat map uses data-testid='seat-{row}-{col}', confirm button is 'confirm-booking-btn'. Token stored in localStorage 'stagepass_token'. No bugs found - app is production-ready for MVP.
